title: The Siberian Tundra Anomaly
narrative_script: Siberian tundra: frozen lake, [ordinary] on maps for decades. Then...
Researchers found something [massive] beneath: a perfectly symmetrical, dark spire.
Not natural. Geometric angles, metallic surface. Scale is truly [shocking].
Submersible found a [sealed] doorway, as if shut from the inside.
Fossilized footprints surrounding the entrance. [Impossible] prints, not entirely human.
visual_prompts: Aerial view of a vast, snow-covered Siberian tundra. A frozen lake dominates the center. Subtle heat distortion effects hint at something hidden beneath the ice.
Sonar scan visualization showing a massive, perfectly symmetrical spire rising from the lakebed. The spire is dark and imposing, contrasting with the surrounding terrain.
Close-up of the sonar scan, highlighting the geometric angles and metallic surface of the spire. The surface appears to absorb sonar waves, creating a sense of mystery.
Underwater view of an unmanned submersible approaching a massive doorway at the base of the spire. The doorway is sealed shut, hinting at something hidden within.
Wide shot of the lake floor surrounding the doorway. Immense, fossilized footprints are pressed deep into the bedrock, suggesting a creature of immense size and unknown origin.
